verdict.rationale: A live probe found a working llms.txt (HTTP 200) at help.cakeequity.com that indexes the Help Centre in structured markdown. The help articles themselves are served as .md URLs, including agent-specific docs on connecting Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or llms.txt coverage beyond the help centre (e.g., main site), no independent/hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
